title: Transfer decision record and ledger read: the decision code, the MSG-P7-009 text, the answer element, the no-version answer and the DP-02 login name are not specified
source: RWB E2 012 Manual transfer and reassignment screen with reason v2.md sections 3, 11, 12, 14 and 16; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.1/A2.2 (AC-P7-001-01, AC-ALT-P7-001-01, AC-ALT-P7-002-01, AC-EXC-P7-002-01, AC-EXC-P7-002-05, AC-EXC-P7-002-07, AC-BG-P7-007-01) and A2.7 (AC-EXC-P7-007-05); TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2
description: The sources give the entry fields of TSD P7 v2 T3.1 and the two decision-log read paths, but not the transfer-specific detail. Missing: the decision code of a transfer record (the legacy story names no decision code; the only code the sources name for this key is the final call CASE_TRANSFERRED, and LOV-DECISION is not written out); the written text of MSG-P7-009, which FSD P7 names but does not quote; the element shape and required fields of DecisionLogPage and DecisionLogEntry beyond the field names of T3.1; the status and body of the version list when no TRANSFER version is in force on the date asked (422 problem or 200 with the finding); the maximum page size of the read; the text of REQ-CWC-010, which legacy BR1 and BR2 cite but do not quote; and the rwb-decision login name of DP-02.
evidence: Legacy section 12 gives the record content (rule ID, rule version, from and to queue and owner, reason code) and the errors of the move, not of the read; section 14 lists no message for a refused record; FSD P7 AC-ALT-P7-002-01 and AC-EXC-P7-002-01 name MSG-P7-009 without its text, and AC-EXC-P7-007-05 names MSG-P3-015 the same way; TSD P7 v2 T-A.2 gives the query parameters and the response names DecisionLogPage and DecisionLogEntry with no fields; no source names the rwb-decision login.
area: Decision ledger, rule registry and API detail
owner_role: P7 business analyst and solution architect, with the API specification owner
proposed: Keep the entry fields of TSD P7 v2 T3.1 as the contract, take the decision code from LOV-DECISION at run time with the value held as reference data, keep the R9 placeholder for the MSG-P7-009 text and for the REQ-CWC-010 text, answer the version list with the finding and MSG-P3-027 when no version is in force, fix the page-size guard as service configuration, and write the DP-02 login as the phrase 'the rwb-decision login (DP-02)'.

title: The DP table adds platform and published contracts that the metadata rows do not carry
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-04, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10, DP-14, DP-15 and DP-19; the story metadata rows; _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P7-E2012-APP.json H and C
description: The metadata rows record Depends on (build) None and Contract dependencies RWB-P3-E2012-CON only. The DP table adds H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON (DP-03), H RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON (DP-04), H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON and C RWB-P3-E1043-CON (DP-07), H RWB-PLT-TE006-CON (DP-09), H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON and H RWB-PLT-E1071-CON (DP-10), H RWB-PLT-E1047-CON (DP-14), H RWB-PLT-E1044-CON (DP-15) and H RWB-PLT-N001-CON (DP-19). None of these appears in the H, C, I or X lists of the plan slice, so the Dependency Map and the Day-1 allocation cannot see them.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-04, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10, DP-14, DP-15 and DP-19; the metadata table of the story names None and RWB-P3-E2012-CON; the fragment H is empty and C holds RWB-P3-E2012-CON only.
owner_role: Delivery lead, with the platform contract owners
proposed: Keep the metadata rows as the plan gives them and record the DP-added H and C in the Dependency Map as non-blocking platform and published contracts, built against their fakes; section 13 of the story keeps them visible.

title: Decision-record event naming and the boundary with RWB-P7-E1008-APP and RWB-P7-E2027-APP
source: Template and Rules v1 R4 and R5.5 DP-14; RWB P7 E1008 APP Decision log store v1, append only and hash chained v1.md sections 1, 12.4 and 12.6 (rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1; the continuous ingest, the chain, the daily seal and the JOB-14 Schedule at 02:00); RWB P7 E2027 APP Payment matching rules with the data team v1.md section 12.3 (rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1); TSD P7 v2 T5.3 (DecisionRecorded, ApprovalRequested)
description: Two decisions are needed before build. First, the event name: DP-14 fixes rwb.<short>.<Event>.v1, which gives rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 on the shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1, while RWB-P7-E2027-APP publishes rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1 for the same record; one of the two forms must be dropped or both filtered. Second, the boundary: RWB-P7-E1008-APP already owns the ingest of rwb.decision-record.v1, the single hash chain, the append-only trigger, the daily seal and the JOB-14 Schedule, so this story must add only the transfer-specific acceptance and the version in force and must not build a second consumer, a second chain or a second Schedule.
evidence: RWB-P7-E1008-APP section 1 and 12.4 name rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1 as the one input of the ledger, and section 12.6 gives DecisionChainCheckWorkflow and the JOB-14 Schedule; RWB-P7-E2027-APP section 12.3 publishes rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1 for the same record type; TSD P7 v2 T5.3 names DecisionRecorded with no topic-qualified name; RWB-P3-E2012-APP publishes the local record of a move on rwb.decision-record.v1.
area: Event naming, ledger ownership and event contract
owner_role: P7 solution architect, with the event platform owner and the API specification owner
proposed: Settle one name, rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 on the shared topic rwb.decision-record.v1, and correct the P7 stories that use the other form before the Kafka Topic and Event Catalog freeze; keep the ingest, the chain and the JOB-14 Schedule in RWB-P7-E1008-APP and let this story register the transfer acceptance and the version in force only.
